Title: Ukraine detains infrastructure minister attempting to flee country
Source: Reuters
Content: Ukraine's infrastructure minister Oleksiy Kuleba was detained on Saturday while allegedly attempting to flee Ukraine, the State Bureau of Investigation (SBI) said, in a rare arrest of a high-ranking official in the war-time country.

Kuleba, 41, was detained at the Rava-Ruska border crossing point in western Ukraine, SBI said in a statement. The bureau said it had opened a criminal case against Kuleba for allegedly leaving the country illegally as a male of conscription age.
